design.estimand: E1 = E_w[ Y_w(N1) - Y_w(N0) ], Y = legal goal reaches per 1,500-call test session

claimLimits: E1 measures what the persisted experience store does without the map in the SAME world and goal it was trained on; it is not transfer, recall, planning or understanding
A LEARNS_WITHOUT_MAP outcome may reflect experience-derived graph reconstruction and path-keyed Q-values; it does not demonstrate map-free spatial reasoning, abstract route planning, or cognition.

the store may describe the part of the graph T itself traversed (in the development worlds T executed 66-76 of 78 directed edges); I7 shows it describes nothing T did not traverse. LEARN-0 does not separate learning a map from experience from any other use of experience

the TOTAL effect of delivering the tested store (all eight persisted components of the world's own map-off training export, together) at the start of a map-off session, versus starting cold, under the same map-off procedure and test seed; it is not the causal contribution of any single component or learning mechanism
